repos_data.description: 开源中国股市（A股）本地数据湖：沪深股票行情、A股股票数据与金融数据，面向量化研究、量化交易与回测，含财务数据、期货数据、资金流向、公告、指数行业与宏观。55 个日更数据集，复权与历史成分内置，行级溯源、PIT，MCP 原生。免注册、免 Token，自托管。Open-source China stock market data lake for quant research, backtesting and AI agents.
PyTorch ML quant research: 213 factors, bias correction, portfolio optimization, backtesting, and System-One/Jev-style decisions.
RL stock selection for China A-share — bundled polars-native factor library (105 Alpha101 + 191 GTJA Alpha191 = 296 factors), board-aware price limits, GPU train + ONNX CPU infer, MIT-licensed.
